decision_rule: Corrected = the value must change before it ships on a map that has to answer 'where did this come from': it adds a fact the cited document does not show, places the fact at the wrong site, misdates it, names the wrong speaker or document for it, tags a judgement as stated, or the quote is not in the document (pdftotext of a fresh download, whitespace and dash normalised, each '...' fragment checked). A clause that is on the same document but outside the quote, or a dropped qualifier that does not change what ships, is confirmed with a note. A permit is read as stating welding at the address as of its date, not the process or material unless named. Unreachable only if the source cannot be reached at all.
